description: Binds an attribute or prop to a JavaScript expression and keeps it in sync. `:src="url"` is shorthand for `v-bind:src="url"`.
Since Vue 3.4, `:id` is shorthand for `:id="id"` when the attribute and the variable share a name.
Attributes like `disabled` are present when the bound value is truthy (or `''`) and removed when it is falsy.
`v-bind="obj"` spreads every key of `obj` as an attribute on the element.
`:[name]="value"` computes the attribute name itself from an expression.
